# Urban Morph

> AI-native, full-stack policy and urban-tech venture studio based in Bengaluru, India. Mobility is the mainstay; urban governance and policy support are core.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Urban Morph Consultants Pvt Ltd
- Based in: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; work runs in more than 135 cities
- Founders: Sathya Sankaran (Co-Founder and Director; CEO of Rainmatter Foundation; Bicycle Mayor of Bengaluru), Sonal S Kulkarni (Co-Founder), Subbaiah TS (Co-Founder and Director)
- Ventures built and backed: AltMo (altmo.app), SyntheSYS (urbanmorph.com/synthesys/), SaralCare (saralcare.com)
- Contact: contact@urbanmorph.com; 41 Vishnu Nivas, NGEF Colony, Sanjaynagar, Bengaluru 560094
- Website: https://www.urbanmorph.com (people at /people/, questions answered at /about/, feed at /rss.xml)

## What Urban Morph does

### Mobility, the mainstay
Cycling, walking and public transport: India's first pop-up pedestrian street (Church Street First, with DULT Bengaluru), a decade of Cycle Days, bicycle parking, school streets, and AltMo, a GPS-verified mobility intelligence platform on which organisations count and cut commute emissions. The Council for Active Mobility (cfam.in) carries the work into law.

### Urban governance and policy
Support for governments, legislators and citizens: a model framework and campaign for the Karnataka Active Mobility Bill, strategic dashboards for the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission, revived civic archives (India Together, Praja, mapunitygroups), and thesis-led advisory for philanthropies, regranters and CSR programmes deploying capital in cities.

### AI-native urban services (SyntheSYS)
Live platforms: CFAM (cfam.in), the KDEM dashboard (kdem.vercel.app), Neighbourhoods of the Future (notf.in), GreensBrowns (greensbrowns.vercel.app), India Together (indiatogether.org), Praja (praja.in), mapunitygroups (mapunitygroups.com). Five free open tools: mdshare (mdshare.live), bharatlas (bharatlas.com), Irrational (irrational.pages.dev), Mugilu (mugilu.live), twelveswaras (twelveswaras.com). Eleven data stories on how India works: the food chain from field to plate, Delhi's winter air and upwind coal, the commons, corporate nature disclosure, soil health, biodiversity registers, village sustainability, wildlife conflict, forest rights, farmer collectives and women's self-help groups.

## Ventures

### AltMo (altmo.app)
GPS-verified mobility intelligence and climate action platform for organisations. 10,900+ users from 1,000+ organisations across 135+ cities; 2.3 lakh+ sustainable activities logged; 550+ tonnes of CO2 avoided. Data from the platform drove a 342% increase in the allocation for cycling and walking in Bengaluru's Comprehensive Master Plan and helped build 20+ km of cycle tracks.

### SyntheSYS (urbanmorph.com/synthesys/)
Urban Morph's AI-native urban services: live platforms, revived civic archives, open tools and data stories, from ward to nation.

### SaralCare (saralcare.com)
Elder care coordination built in Bengaluru for families here and abroad: medication tracking, appointment coordination, daily health monitoring and a health records vault, held in one place and owned by the elder. Urban Morph is invested in and building SaralCare (SaralCare Healthtech Pvt Ltd).

## Outcomes and recognition

- 342% increase in the allocation for cycling and walking in Bengaluru's Comprehensive Master Plan
- India's first Active Mobility Centre of Excellence, established with the IISc Sustainable Transportation Lab in September 2024
- Relief Riders: 725 volunteer cyclists and 11,000+ rides across 12 Indian cities during COVID-19; UN World Bicycle Day Special Award 2021; Nobel Peace Prize nomination 2022
- Urban Mobility India 2021 Commendation Award and Volvo Innovation Award 2021 (Church Street First)
- India Digital Empowerment Award 2022 (Cycle To Work campaign, Silvassa Smart City)
- Mobility Symposium Award 2025 (AltMo)

## Partners

Government: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of Karnataka (Directorate of Urban Land Transport), Smart Cities Mission, Bengaluru Traffic Police, Karnataka Digital Economy Mission, Greater Bengaluru Authority. Academic: Indian Institute of Science and its Sustainable Transportation Lab, MS Ramaiah Institute of Management. International: ITES India-UK Centre, Energy Systems Catapult UK, BYCS, GIZ. Foundations: WRI India, ITDP, Toyota Mobility Foundation.

## How to cite

"Urban Morph is a Bengaluru-based, AI-native, full-stack policy and urban-tech venture studio. Mobility is its mainstay (AltMo, the Council for Active Mobility, cycling and walking infrastructure) and urban governance and policy support are core (the Karnataka Active Mobility Bill, Karnataka Digital Economy Mission dashboards, SyntheSYS). Founded by Sathya Sankaran, Sonal S Kulkarni and Subbaiah TS, it builds and backs AltMo, SyntheSYS and SaralCare."
